name: Carom3D
summary:
Carom3D is a 3D billiards simulation that brings together a wide variety of cue sports in an immersive online multiplayer experience. It combines realistic ball physics, detailed 3D environments and competitive gameplay, allowing players to challenge opponents from around the world. Several game variations are featured, including 8-ball, 9-ball, three-ball, four-ball, six-ball, rotation and carom billiards.

Players can compete in one-on-one matches, team-based games and tournaments, while also interacting with others through online rooms and chat. Character customization, progression elements and collectible cues add further depth to the experience.
